Welcome to Durian Village RP (Kampung Durian),  meet new friends, choose your character, and explore the village!

🏘️ Own and live in traditional houses!
🚗 Drive from village to town!
✨ Choose your character for roleplay!
💵 Get a job to earn some money!
🙋‍♂️ Roleplaying with other players and make new friends!

Join group "Voltraz Studios" to expand our malaysia community
